name: Mixed EN/JP escalation — contract at risk with deadline ultimatum
transcript:
[00:00:07] Client: We need to address the delivery delays seriously. This is not acceptable.
[00:00:14] Kenji: 大変申し訳ございません。ご不便をおかけしております。
[00:00:20] Client: Kenji-san, this is the third delay this quarter. We needed this system live last Friday.
[00:00:28] Kenji: はい、サーバーの問題が発生しました。現在対応中です。
[00:00:35] Client: I need a written commitment from you that this will be resolved by Monday. If this is not resolved by Monday, we will have to reconsider our contract.
[00:00:46] Kenji: 書面でのコミットメントをご提供いたします。月曜日までに必ずシステムを稼働させます。
[00:00:55] Client: We also need a compensation proposal for the downtime we have experienced. Our operations have been impacted.
[00:01:03] Kenji: 承知いたしました。補償案については本日中に上司に確認して、明日までにご提案いたします。
[00:01:13] Client: Good. Monday for the system launch and tomorrow for the compensation proposal. We are watching this very closely.

summary: Client cited three delivery delays this quarter and demanded system launch by Monday.
Client threatened contract reconsideration if the Monday deadline is not met.
Kenji committed to a written system launch commitment and will propose compensation by tomorrow.

action_items.task: Provide written commitment for system launch
